[[Club Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]] | league topscorer = [[Eduardo Esidio]] (37 goals) | prevseason = [[1999 Torneo Descentralizado|1999]] | nextseason = [[2001 Torneo Descentralizado|2001]] }} The '''2000 season of the [[Torneo Descentralizado]]''' was the 85th season of the top category of [[Peru]]vian [[football (soccer)]]. It was played by 12 teams. The national champion was [[Club Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]].[https://universitario.pe/noticias/historia/universitario-y-un-tricampeonato-monumental Universitario y un tricampeonato monumental][https://elcomercio.pe/deporte-total/futbol-peruano/universitario-de-deportes-la-colosal-celebracion-del-tricampeonato-un-dia-como-hoy-hace-20-anos-descentralizado-2000-liga-1-noticia/ Universitario de Deportes: la colosal celebración del tricampeonato un día como hoy hace 20 años][https://dechalaca.com/especiales-dechalaca/20-anos-del-descentralizado/2000-tri-monumental 2000: Tri monumental] == Competition modus == The national championship was divided into two tournaments, the [[Apertura and Clausura|Torneo Apertura]] and the [[Apertura and Clausura|Torneo Clausura]]. Each was played on a home-and-away [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The winners of each would play for the national title in a play-off, but since the same club had won both tournaments, it automatically won the national championship. Following-season [[Copa Libertadores]] berths went to the champion, as well as to each of the half-year tournament's runners-up, who held a play-off as a formality to decide the overall season runners-up. The bottom team on the aggregate table was relegated, while the eleventh place team held a promotion play-off against the winner of the Segunda División (Second Division). == Teams == Before the start of the season, [[Deportivo Wanka|Deportivo Pesquero]] relocated from [[Chimbote]] to [[Huancayo]] and changed its name to [[Deportivo Wanka]].{{cite web |url = https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/peru00.html |title = Peru 2000 Primera División |access-date = 8 December 2011 |date = 16 October 2004 |publisher = rsssf.org}} ===Team changes=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
